arguments.command:
python3 - <<'PYREPLAY'
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, importlib
expected=(Path.cwd() / 'deepdiff/lfucache.py').resolve()
try:
 module = importlib.import_module('deepdiff.lfucache')
except Exception as import_error:
 traceback=import_error.__traceback__
 while traceback is not None:
  file=traceback.tb_frame.f_globals.get('__file__')
  if file and Path(file).resolve()==expected:
   print('source_binding', str(expected), 'sha256', hashlib.sha256(expected.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), 'actual_import_failure_frame')
  traceback=traceback.tb_next
 raise
actual=Path(module.__file__).resolve()
print("source_binding", str(actual), "sha256", hashlib.sha256(actual.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
assert actual == expected, (actual, expected)
from deepdiff.lfucache import LFUCache
c = LFUCache(3)
c.set("a", value="1")
c.set("b", value="2")
c.set("c", value="3")
assert c.freq_link_head.freq == 0
assert c.freq_link_head.count_caches() == 3
c.get("a")
assert c.freq_link_head.freq == 0
assert c.freq_link_head.count_caches() == 2
c.set("d", value="4")
print("head_after_dump", c.freq_link_head.freq, c.freq_link_head.count_caches())
assert c.freq_link_head.freq == 0, f"head freq {c.freq_link_head.freq}"
assert ("b" in c) is False, "b evicted"
assert ("c" in c) is True, "c retained isolation"
assert ("a" in c) is True
assert ("d" in c) is True
assert c.get("c") == "3"
assert c.get("a") == "1"
print("dump_head_scope", True)
c.set("b", value="2-recomputed")
assert c.get("b") == "2-recomputed"
print("recompute", True)
assert c.get("a") == "1"
print("equivalence", True)

PYREPLAY
